messages:
Maria Gonzales: Heads-up: we have a customer report that the model card for zephyr-mini-4b-quant lists max_seq=2048 but the runtime now supports 4096 with quant-profile=v2. Need a docs PR to update limits, add streaming caveats, and include an SDK snippet that demonstrates embedding fallback behavior.

Ashok Patel: Confirmed. quant-profile=v2 increases usable context to 4096 at ~1.15-1.25x memory. I ran microbenchmarks; will attach numbers.

Sophie Lee: Good catch. For the card edits we'll need to change the limits table entry, add a paragraph in "Compatibility" about streaming/kv-cache behavior, update example snippets (py/ts), and link to the quant-profiles migration doc. Also suggest a short note about higher tail latency for very long contexts.

Maria Gonzales: Exact edit list: (a) limits.max_sequence_length -> 4096 (when quant-profile=v2), (b) compatibility: streaming + kv-cache prefetch guidance, (c) client examples updated, (d) migration guide link to /docs/migrations/quant-profiles.

Ashok Patel: Attached bench highlights (p4d):
```
model: zephyr-mini-4b-quant (quant-profile=v2)
seq_len: 4096
throughput: 82 tokens/sec/pod
p95 latency (single request, 1-token gen): 430ms
p99 latency: 1.02s
```
Compared to seq_len 2048: throughput ~138 tok/s, p99 ~690ms. I'll upload CSV to bench-storage.

Tanner Wu: Runtime note for docs: streaming works, but to avoid repeated recompute when rolling back during streaming you should enable kv compaction for quant v2. Add the curl example showing runtime_options.enable_kv_compaction=true. Without it long prefixes can hit OOM.

Li Huang: Draft SDK examples: show async streaming with a low-precision hint and an embeddings call with hybrid fallback. Python snippet draft:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="...")
# async stream with low-precision hint
stream = c.stream("zephyr-mini-4b-quant", runtime_options={"quant_profile":"v2", "precision_hint":"low"})
for chunk in stream:
    print(chunk.text)
# embeddings with hybrid fallback
resp = c.embeddings.create(model="zephyr-mini-4b-quant", input="...", embedding_mode="hybrid")
```
Add comment: hybrid routes to hosted embedding pipeline if local quant path can't match quality.

Sophie Lee: I'll open the PR updating the card, include both py/ts snippets, add a short migration note about tokenizer EOS behavior change in zephyr v2, and fix canonical model URL (old link was /models/zephyr-mini-4b which 302s).

deploy-bot: PR opened by @Sophie Lee: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4870 — includes bench CSV and snippet updates :rocket:

Sophie Lee: Requesting reviews from @Ashok, @Tanner, @Li. Also adding QA for sample validation in CI.

qa-bot: PR #4870 checklist:
- [ ] limits table updated to note quant-profile=v2 4096 support
- [ ] streaming compat + curl snippet (enable_kv_compaction)
- [ ] SDK examples (py + ts) added
- [ ] migration link to quant-profiles added
- [ ] bench CSV attached under docs/benchmarks/zephyr-mini-4b/
Please add simple test vectors under docs/samples/zephyr-mini-4b/ for CI.

Ashok Patel: I'll validate the CSV and bench assertions. If numbers look fine I'll approve.

Tanner Wu: I'll verify the kv compaction guidance with runtime. If we need a config flag change, we'll coordinate a small release note.

Li Huang: I'll add the TS snippet and a unit test for the streaming example in devex/snippets.

Maria Gonzales: Thanks team — marking this as sprint priority since customers are hitting the mismatch between card and runtime. :thumbsup:

Sophie Lee: Plan to merge once reviewers sign off, then follow up to add a one-line note to the catalog release notes about the context expansion.
